title: Unreadable Joomla bind responses retain safe diagnostics and refuse acceptance
steps: Run the real PHP contract bootstrap response tests.
expect: HTML, warning-prefixed JSON and unexpected JSON report bounded fixed categories without exposing response bodies, arbitrary keys or MIME values.
Successful bind responses remain unchanged; HTTP refusals retain their status and cannot count as accepted binds.
fence: Diagnostic decoding only; bind verification and retry behavior remain unchanged.

tests: unreadable bind responses expose bounded categories without leaking response data
response diagnostics preserve successful binds and HTTP refusals
